MULTIPLAYER PUZZLE

Blocky Block Worlds

Lootheads · iOS & Android

A multiplayer puzzle game where classic block gameplay meets real-time competition. Drag and place blocks, complete rows and columns, build satisfying combo chains, and keep the board open as you plan several moves ahead. Play relaxing solo sessions to chase a personal high score, or join live 1v1 matches against players around the world and outscore them before the match ends.

Unity 6 · C# · Go · Nakama · PostgreSQL · Redis · Docker

MULTIPLAYER ACTION

Trailz

Lootheads · iOS & Android

A fast-paced multiplayer action game where speed and strategy collide. Climb ranked leagues, take on live events and daily challenges, upgrade driver skills, earn card drops, and compete on local and global leaderboards.
